schema.title: Delete a credit card payment method from an account.

account_identifier.description: The identifier for the platform account to fund.

description:
Hello Team,

Could you please remove the credit‑card payment method associated with token **tok_12345abc** for our customer **john_doe_92**? The deletion should be applied to the account identified by **+++ww**. Thank you for processing this request promptly.
